Somaliland is a country with deep historical roots and a unique cultural identity, closely linked to Ethiopia, Yemen, and Eritrea. Its heritage is recognised by Greeks, Arabs, Indians, Jews, and the Habesha peoples, from whom many of today’s inhabitants descend, reflecting shared ancestry and longstanding cultural ties. 
The Ancient mountain inscriptions — in Hebrew, Ge’ez, Greek, and other early scripts — testify to its deep antiquity, early human civilisations, enduring legacy and rich history.
